name: superstoffer
description: Christoffer Baadsgaard's Claude Code skills. triage turns unstructured input into well-formed issues in your tracker; design-doc drafts and reviews software design docs; nest supplies NestJS v12/v12.1 and ORM version knowledge the model cannot have, fetches live docs chapters for the rest, and verifies generated code compiles; visual-design encodes the visual craft Claude skips unaided — OKLCH palettes, single emphasis, and an optical pass. agentic-security-review audits a skill, plugin, MCP server, or hook against the OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 before install. application-security-review reviews your own application code against the OWASP frameworks that apply — ASVS 5.0, Top 10:2025, and the API Security Top 10 — with cheat-sheet remediation. nuxt supplies the Nuxt release boundary the docs blur — what the installed 4.x actually ships versus what the docs already describe — plus compatibilityVersion 5 behaviour, and verifies code typechecks, builds, and its server routes respond.
